parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The query end time based on the task completion time, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The query start time based on the task creation time, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: StatusCodes
parameters.description: The list of operation subtask status codes.

parameters.name: TaskIds
parameters.description: The list of operation task IDs.
